documents.title: Proceeding Of 3Rd Annual General Meeting Held On 31 July 2026
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Board Meeting Outcome for Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For The Quarter Ended June 30,2026

analysis.summary: Chembond Chemicals Limited reported full-year FY26 consolidated revenue of Rs. 326.15 crores, representing a 12% increase YoY, driven mainly by its water technologies business. Management highlighted second-half consolidated revenue of Rs. 188 crores, up 35% compared to the first half. Raw material cost inflation driven by metals and post-war disruptions impacted margins by approximately 3 percentage points in the immediate month.

guidance.claim: Management foresees around 15 to 20% volume growth in construction chemicals in quarter one of the year.
guidance.quote: Coming to quarter one of this year, we foresee around 15 to 20% of volume growth in construction chemicals.

guidance.claim: The company expects volume growth in water chemicals to be roughly 10%.
guidance.quote: Water chemicals, it would be roughly around 10%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that all business units have strong sales pipelines and a positive sales growth outlook.
demand_outlook.quote: All of these businesses are having strong sales pipelines and we see that the sales growth outlook looks positive across all these business units.

demand_outlook.claim: Chembond is experiencing significant growth in sealants and plans to consolidate its market presence through polysulfide and PU sealants.
demand_outlook.quote: Sealants, we are seeing a significant growth and we intend to consolidate our presence in that segment through our polysulfide and PU sealants.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for the year reached around 21 crores, reflecting the full year impact of the demerger, office building renovation, and property, plant, and equipment added to the books.
capex_expansion.quote: And of course, the office building, the improvements that we've done and the The entire renovation of the office building to house our teams, so that has taken up, but twenty-one crores, whole demerger, yeah, P.P.E. which has come into our books, so this is the demerger effect.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested ₹90.76 lakhs during FY 2025-26 to install the solar renewable energy plant at Dudhwada.
capex_expansion.quote: ₹90.76 lakhs were invested towards installation of the 350 kVA solar renewable energy plant at the Dudhwada, Gujarat manufacturing site during FY 2025-26.

margins_costs.claim: Material costs began rising from late February and March due to volatility in metal-based key inputs like zinc and molybdenum.
margins_costs.quote: Material costs started increasing from March, end of Feb, March. A lot of volatility in metals before that. So some key materials that we use are based on metals, so zinc and molybdenum and stuff like that.

margins_costs.claim: Chembond experienced an immediate monthly impact of about 3% on margins due to elevated raw material costs.
margins_costs.quote: But in the immediate month, we saw about a 3% impact on our margins due to these haywire costs.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that while the revenue outlook remains positive, earnings profitability presents a challenge.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue outlook continues to remain positive. However, on the earnings, profitability is a little bit of a challenge right now.

orders_capacity.claim: Chembond is entering the new financial year with a strong order book for its chemicals business.
orders_capacity.quote: So we are starting this financial year with a strong order book for our chemicals business also.

orders_capacity.claim: The water business achieved a 50% increase in volume during the second half.
orders_capacity.quote: So 50% increase in terms of volume for our water business and most of this is carrying forward.

capital_allocation.claim: The company intends to deploy some of its cash balance towards network growth and geographical expansion.
capital_allocation.quote: We intend to deploy some of it in network growth and geographical expansion.

capital_allocation.claim: Chembond maintains a tight credit policy, with days sales outstanding for construction chemicals standing at around 88 days as of March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: We are maintaining a tight credit policy and our day sales outstanding for construction chemicals is around 88 days as on 31st of March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of ₹1.25 per equity share aggregating to ₹336.20 lakhs for FY 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board has recommended a final dividend of ₹1.25 (Rupee One and Paise Twenty-Five only) per equity share of ₹5 (Rupees Five only) each, aggregating to ₹336.20 lakhs for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Public sector units represent about 30% of the water business and refused to accept force majeure until the government declared it.
risks_headwinds.quote: About 30 percent of our total business in the water business comes from public sector units, and none of them had accepted a force majeure until the government just declared it two weeks ago.

risks_headwinds.claim: Public sector clients are refusing to amend contract terms during periods of cost increases.
risks_headwinds.quote: Public sector is a different story. They are refusing to amend the terms. And for that, then our only hope is that the situation starts getting better.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management described the period following the war declaration as very challenging.
risks_headwinds.quote: And post-war declaration, it was a very challenging period.

management_commitments.claim: Management foresees around 15 to 20% volume growth in construction chemicals in quarter one.
management_commitments.quote: Coming to quarter one of this year, we foresee around 15 to 20% of volume growth in construction chemicals.

management_commitments.claim: Management foresees roughly 10% volume growth in water chemicals.
management_commitments.quote: Water chemicals, it would be roughly around 10%.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
